LAMP Fellowship 2027–28 (Legislative Assistants to MPs)

Eleven-month fellowship working with a Member of Parliament on legislative research, with training by PRS Legislative Research.

STIPEND / MONTH
₹23,000
Stipend details
₹23,000 per month for the duration of the fellowship.
Expected application window
To be confirmed
Format & location
In person · New Delhi
Who can apply
Indian citizens aged 25 or under with a bachelor's degree in any discipline completed before the fellowship starts. Open to arts, commerce, science, law and engineering graduates.
Accommodation & support
Fellow arranges own housing in Delhi · no office equipment provided · intensive training and policy workshops included

Entry notes

  • The form typically opens in December, with an online test in January and results by end-March. The last cycle closed 21 December 2025.
  • Policy
